rule: Name is not an X-* extension at all.
Cross-system V* extension on the stabilization track. X-VSTAR-HASH is the only mandatory member in v0.1.
Extension owned by one consuming system (e.g. X-AGR-INTENT). SYSTEM is any slug other than VSTAR or EXP, and the name after it MUST be non-empty.
Experimental / unstable extension. Senders MUST NOT depend on receivers honoring these.
Carries the X- prefix but matches no sanctioned tier (e.g. "X-", "X-VSTAR-", "X-FOO"). Treat as opaque; receivers MUST still ignore it per RFC 5545.
